org-covert-years-sum.label: programme-years undetected across the seven undeclared programmes
org-covert-years-sum.formula: sum(org-iraq-years, org-libya-years, org-iran-years, org-fordow-years-low, org-syria-years, org-biopreparat-years, org-sa-years)

path-covert-days-1e26.label: days for the untraced chip pool, read as H100e at the reference utilisation, to run 1e26 FLOP

path-horizon-p80-next-year.label: 80% time horizon a year on, if it grows at the 50% horizon's annual multiple

claim-d5-organisms.label: locked organisms per budget, with none missed, for the one-sided upper bound on the miss rate to reach its target

claim-c12-pairs.label: pairs of pathways in the pathways chapter's ranking
claim-c12-pairs.formula: n * (n - 1) / 2 for the pathways chapter's n pathways

claim-c12-pareto-two.label: pairs of pathways fixed by the evidence on the ranking's two criteria, effect on the line and how hard it is to see: one pathway graded higher on both
claim-c12-pareto-two.formula: pairs (a, b) with claim-c12-effect-a > claim-c12-effect-b and claim-c12-hidden-a > claim-c12-hidden-b
claim-c12-pareto-two.note: an ordinal reading of the pathways table; every other order is a judgement

claim-c12-pareto-three.label: the same count on the three criteria the red team read, cost of a limit included
claim-c12-pareto-three.formula: pairs (a, b) graded higher on effect, hidden and cheap alike
claim-c12-pareto-three.note: checks the grades against the red team's independent reading (L4, C12.1)

formal-d5-organisms-one-miss.label: locked organisms per budget for the exact one-sided bound on the miss rate to reach its target when one organism is missed
formal-d5-organisms-one-miss.formula: smallest n with P(Bin(n, claim-d5-miss-target) <= 1) <= 1 - claim-confidence

formal-d5-organisms-two-miss.label: locked organisms per budget for the exact one-sided bound on the miss rate to reach its target when two organisms are missed
formal-d5-organisms-two-miss.formula: smallest n with P(Bin(n, claim-d5-miss-target) <= 2) <= 1 - claim-confidence

formal-floor-bound-1e26-pause-bf16.label: the same floor for a run held to BF16, at full utilisation

formal-floor-ref-over-bound.label: factor by which the physical chapter's floor (reference utilisation, BF16 peak) exceeds the bound

formal-pool-over-floor-bound.label: median compute smuggled into one country through 2025, as a multiple of the 1e26 FLOP pause floor taken as a bound (full utilisation, FP8)

formal-inrun-line-factor-high.label: the same factor at the high end of the ledger's algorithmic drift interval

prot-line-declared.label: breakout time below which a declared holding is weapons-grade, at the illustrative margin and response time

prot-lambda-declared.label: detection rate the declared channels need to reach the tolerated miss chance within the DPRK detection time

prot-lambda-over-history.label: that rate as a multiple of E5's fitted historical discovery rate of covert programmes (a lower bound on the multiple, as E5's rate is an upper bound for a careful evader)

prot-pool-years-fixed.label: years for the median smuggled stock to reach the hardwired-pause breakout budget at fixed algorithms

prot-coalition-share-inrun-high.label: largest coalition share on declared, licensed compute at the hardwired-pause budget when runs absorb drift at the high end of the ledger's drift interval (Proposition 7.1 with Corollary 1.6a; a lower bound on the share, as the factor is an upper bound)

prot-coalition-inrun-headroom.label: whole-fleet horizon over the declared line at launch speed with central in-run drift: above 1, the cap at s* = 1 binds and the whole fleet sits outside the line by this factor

prot-notice-months.label: withdrawal notice the line asks of a member whose holding has fallen to the response time, at the illustrative margin
